questions.q: What does the author say about human beings?
options: They cannot prosper without cooperating with each other.
They share a common interest and believe in a just cause.
They think and behave alike in different social groups.
They cannot gain independence without fighting for it.

options: It gives rise to a complicated division of labor.
It involves many aspects with great complexity.
It brings individuals together as environment changes.
It embraces the characteristics of different individuals.
